column4: a race finish line archway made of two tall riveted scrap-metal pillars and one crossbeam on top, the crossbeam painted with a bold black and white checkered flag pattern, a fully open archway with nothing between the pillars, wide like a road gate

a race starting line archway made of two tall timber posts and one timber crossbeam on top, the crossbeam hung with a row of red and gold pennant flags and two brass lanterns, a fully open archway with nothing between the posts, wide like a road gate
